units: metres, Y up, X east, Z south; bonfire at the origin

longhouse.gable_horns: 2 crossed 3-sided beams per gable, 1.0 m above the ridge

props.screen: teal emissive quad on the face toward the fire, flickers

props.kind: rifle rack (3 rifles leaning on a rail)

lighting.formula: L = ambient + moon*max(0,N.moonDir) + fire/(1+(d/fire_range)^2)*clamp(0.8*N.toFire+0.2,0,1); warm ramp if fire term > 0.9*moon term (then L uses moon*0.5); cold ramp index = L/0.5*n, warm = L/1.6*n, Bayer 4x4
